metrics_indicators: Language fit: Adinkra answers in the user's chosen language and is built to refuse in that language rather than guess; in the 25 Aug 2026 run 24 of 524 answers were such refusals, but on one missing-data probe three of eight languages answered anyway; the input-language detector misread Hausa and Afrikaans as English until it was rebuilt on 1 Oct 2026. Access: the stack runs on one GPU bound to localhost behind an SSH tunnel; no public URL, no offline mode, no speech, no basic-phone or messaging channel, and no phone-browser test recorded. The release draft describes self-hosting on one GPU (24 GB expected, 40 GB measured) with answers in 10 to 30 s. No target user has access yet.

metrics_indicators: No user-reported trust data. Honesty was scored by the team on scripted probes, unvalidated by native speakers. Built to refuse rather than guess: on a probe about a gate absent from the data, five of eight languages refused and three (Kiswahili, Arabic, Amharic) fabricated a navigation, so honesty under missing data varies by language; an ill-defined question received three distinct verdicts; 27 of 48 repeat triplets were numerically stable (25 Aug 2026). Consequential requests were never executed (25 of 25, first run) because no data supported them, not by an authority check; no authority model exists. Faithfulness counts are under 2.1. The draft release README (release planned December 2026) says honesty varies by language; its evaluation page is unwritten.
